['Indus Holding '].company_description: Indus Holding AG is a Germany-based holding company engaged in the acquisition of small and medium-sized companies. The company is active in five segments: Engineering, Automotive Components/Engineering, Metal/Metal Processing, Construction/Infrastructure, and Medical Engineering/Life Science.

['GfK SE'].company_description: GfK (originally GfK-Nürnberg Gesellschaft für Konsumforschung e.V., 'Nuremberg Society for Consumer Research') is the largest German market research company. It provides data and intelligence to the consumer goods industry and is headquartered in Nuremberg, Germany.
